final: WITH by_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS overall_avg_ana FROM by_sex) SELECT by_sex.sex, by_sex.avg_acl_igg, by_sex.avg_ana, by_sex.avg_ana / overall.overall_avg_ana FROM by_sex JOIN overall ON overall.overall_avg_ana IS NOT NULL
